market.question: Will there be exactly 4 major space weather events this week?

assessment.reasoning: NOAA SWPC short-term forecast shows quiet conditions May 1-3, no G3 expected, only slight S3/R3 chances. Hitting EXACTLY 4 strong (level-3+) events in a single week is unusual; modal weekly count is 0-1 even at solar maximum.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Late-cycle solar activity could surprise with an active region rotating into geoeffective position.
